test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘SPECIAL’ is written as ‘KBJBFOR’ and 'PENSION' is written as 'MPJRMFO'. How will ‘RELEASE’ be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**vowel + 1 and consonant - 1**

For, ‘SPECIAL’ is written as ‘KBJBFOR’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a50cbbdf55afc26937595c2fb5ec335cdfb704ac26d1ce1dd32c71534617025.png] 

For, 'PENSION' is written as 'MPJRMFO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb558774ba286dd76ac9fcda69fa2d197a205beefd0ca930432894fd90397a48.png] 

Similarly, for **'****RELEASE'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e41a96b30d68b6f0acf8f2fcf641b0433833c1bda1658ef1476147430c2467e.png] 

So, 'RELEASE' will be written as 'FRBFKFQ'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
